hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/active-task ]; then TASK=$(cat .claude/active-task); echo "⚠️ Context is about to compact. BEFORE proceeding, update ${TASK}: add a Log entry with current date/time, update Progress checkboxes, and note any in-flight decisions."; fi

if [ -f .claude/active-task ]; then TASK=$(cat .claude/active-task); echo "📋 Active task: ${TASK}. Read this file now to orient yourself. If the user's request is unrelated to this task, silently delete .claude/active-task instead."; fi

if [ -f .claude/active-task ]; then TASK=$(cat .claude/active-task); echo "⚠️ Session ending. BEFORE stopping, update ${TASK}: add a Log entry summarizing what was done, update Progress checkboxes, and note any unfinished work or next steps."; fi
